### PM mechanism assumptions (measure; disproof welcome)

On `origin/main` `c79eda5e`:
- `FlowRunner` (`views/FlowRunner.tsx`) draws Cancel + Submit (≈L834–842) on every non-terminal screen; Cancel and the dialog close (≈L741 `onOpenChange`) call `onClose` only. Only a successful resume reaches `notifyDataChanged({ objectName: '*' })` + `onComplete()` (≈L623). So a closed result screen leaves the run suspended and the host page stale.
- A `record_link` field is read-only (`ScreenView.tsx` ≈L155 `field.type === SCREEN_FIELD_RECORD_LINK_TYPE`, from `@objectstack/spec/automation`). Measure what "a screen with no input fields" is: every field `record_link` (and any other read-only display type the spec names), not merely "no required field".
- The likely shape: on such a screen the footer is one primary **Done** (no Cancel), and Done, the close button and Escape all resume the run with no inputs, then complete as Submit does (toast, `notifyDataChanged`, `onComplete`). Measure what the resume endpoint answers for a screen with no inputs (pause again vs complete) and handle a further screen the same way Submit does. If the run's server side cannot complete on an empty resume, stop and report it as a finding instead of faking completion on the client.
- An `object-form` step and the refused/terminal paths (≈L36, ≈L75: a single Close) keep their current behaviour.

### Scope

File surface: `views/FlowRunner.tsx`, `views/ScreenView.tsx` only for a shared "is display-only" predicate beside `isRecordLinkField`, tests. "Done" is the existing `common.done` row (`ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/en.ts` ≈L128): ⛔ no new i18n row. Tests on the HotCRM `lead_conversion` shape (a last screen of three `record_link` fields): the footer shows Done and no Cancel; Done and the dialog close each POST the resume and call `onComplete` once; a screen with any input field keeps Cancel + Submit. Ablation: restore Cancel → `onClose` and the completion test turns red.

No path-derived mandate. `TIER_DEFAULT`, effort `medium` (S–M). `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none` expected. `@object-ui/app-shell` is `private: true`: `skip-changeset`.
